messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: GPU pool eu-west-1 saturated (scalechain controller error). queue: 3,200 reqs, throttle: 95% — pager->oncall_anna.

anna (oncall): seeing it, acked. I'm on mobile, brb in 2m. +hand-off to @sanjay for infra-side.

sanjay (infra): on it. quick status: autoscaler is failing to spin new nodes, getting repeated 429/timeout from provider. scalechain logs show controller stuck in backoff.

marta (runtime): confirmed increased token latencies and 5xxs from the hosted API routing layer. We have many inflight KV-cache misses. Dropping non-critical batching might help short-term.

anna (oncall): customers reporting generation timeouts and 502s. Support already seeing a spike. @zara can you surface a list of high-traffic tenants?

zara (support): pulling top 10 affected orgs now. Early list: acme-ai, glide-saas, pickly. Messaging outbound to account contacts with ETA TBD.

sanjay (infra): grabbing controller logs. snippet: ```
2026-03-15T02:24:12Z scalechain-controller ERROR backoff-loop failed to acquire capacity: provider API timeout (504)
2026-03-15T02:24:13Z scalechain-controller WARN consecutive_backoff 5
```

tyler (sre): can we failover traffic to eu-central pool? What's the compatibility matrix for fallback models?

marta (runtime): eu-central has compatible 1.5/quant variants but lower throughput. We can route 30% of new requests to eu-central quickly using policy rules. Will add smart-rate-limit to avoid immediate overload.

anna (oncall): do it. @marta proceed with routing and reduce batch size to 8 across the board. Also enable prefix-KV caching for hot endpoints.

marta (runtime): applying routing change now. command: ```sh
redwoodctl route update --from-pool eu-west-1 --to-pool eu-central --pct 30 --sticky false
```
status: applied, verifying traffic shift.

sanjay (infra): I can provision a hot standby node group if provider API recovers. For immediate relief, I'm increasing autoscaler max nodes from 200 -> 260 to avoid hit the hard limit (temp). Updating infra config.

incident-bot: Incident note: mitigation action created #mitigations/4105123456/1 by marta (runtime).

zara (support): customer comms: sent initial notification to impacted accounts: short note + apology + "we're working on mitigations, ETA 30-45m". No escalations yet.

anna (oncall): update: after routing 30% to eu-central and lowering batch size, queue dropped to ~1,100 in 7m. Latency improved for a subset of tenants. Still seeing throttles ~12%.

sanjay (infra): provider API warmed up. controller backoff cleared. spinning new nodes now, expected join in ~6m. logs: ```
2026-03-15T02:31:10Z provider API OK
2026-03-15T02:31:15Z scalechain-controller INFO resumed scaling operations
```

marta (runtime): rebalancing KV caches, warming hot prefixes for acme-ai and pickly. Running lightweight prefetch for frequent prompts.

anna (oncall): support, can you confirm if any paid customers filed tickets/pressed support?

zara (support): two priority-1 tickets opened from enterprise customers, they're on conference. I've offered SRE liaison. One customer asked for rate-limited fallback option (we're on it).

tyler (sre): post-mitigation checklist: 1) confirm autoscaler no longer hitting hard limits; 2) verify no docs of queue growth in the next 30m; 3) snapshot controller state for postmortem. I'll take 1&3.

sanjay (infra): nodes healthy, scaled to 245/260. No hitting provider quota. Recommend follow-up to add provider-side retries + backoff jitter to scalechain.

marta (runtime): production metrics look stable-ish. Streaming errors decreased from 14% -> 2.3%. We'll keep routing for 10 more minutes then gradually shift back.

incident-bot: auto-escalation check: support+oncall+infra present. Incident severity set to SEV2.

anna (oncall): moving to incident review channel after stabilization. Action items for postmortem: - root cause: investigate provider API timeouts + scalechain backoff handling - engineering: add circuit-breaker and jitter to autoscaler - runtime: default smaller max batch for eu-west under queue pressure - ops: add playbook step to failover cross-region earlier - support: customer follow-ups and impact log

zara (support): I'll keep customers updated with timeline. We offered 1:1 tech sync to any enterprise affected.

sanjay (infra): opened infra ticket INFRA-5792 to add exponential backoff + provider retry wrapper. ETA for patch: 2w.

marta (runtime): created runtime ticket RUNTIME-3219 to add automatic cross-region routing trigger when queue > 1k for 5m. ETA 1w.

anna (oncall): final note: incident declared mitigated at 02:40Z, queue < 200, throttles under 1%. We'll run a blameless postmortem tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Assign owners: sanjay (root cause), marta (runtime action), tyler (SRE follow-up), zara (customer comms).

incident-bot: Incident closed for oncall. Postmortem invite created: #postmortems/4105123456.

zara (support): adding impact summary for the postmortem: ~45 orgs affected, peak of 502/timeout errors for ~25 minutes, high-traffic tenants saw degraded throughput ~30-45% increase in latency.

anna (oncall): thanks team. I'll draft the incident timeline and initial RCA notes before the review. :thumbsup:
